# Mike Collins Watchdog File

Subject: Mike Collins, Republican, GA, running for U.S. Senate in 2026
Current office: U.S. House GA-10
Compiled: 2026-10-23 for the On Point Politics watchdog database, onpointpolitics.us
Status: queued for hand research, priority 2. This file holds the roster facts, the office levers, and FEC pipeline data when the pipeline has run. It is not yet a finished Tier 2 profile.

## Race

Race status: nominee. Rating: Cook: Likely Democrat. Current holder of the seat: Jon Ossoff.
Opponents: Jon Ossoff, Democrat.
Roster note: won June 16 GOP Senate runoff

## Committee assignments

- House Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure
